subject: SIG: PR audit trail, emergency change exception log, and ephemeral secrets handoff
messages:
From: Audrey Collins <audrey.collins@bluebank.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: sig@bluebank.com
Date: Thu, 01 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG request: PR audit exports + emergency change exceptions + secrets handoff

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for the quick intake on this — BlueBank is in the middle of our SIG assessment and we need a compact evidence packet covering a few Secure SDLC areas: specifically a PR audit trail for the last 90 days, any emergency/exception change records (approvals, timestamps, and rollback notes), and the handoff records for ephemeral secrets (who activated escrow or emergency KMS access and when).

Could you provide: 
- Export of PR metadata (author, reviewers, approval timestamps, merge commit ids) for repos: infra-serving, runtime-core, api-gateway.
- A spreadsheet/listing of emergency change exceptions since 2026-06-01 with approver names and justification text.
- Notes on how ephemeral secrets are provisioned in CI (brief snippets of pipeline steps and references to where the rotation logs live).

If you already have a ZIP or a single bundle we can ingest, that would be ideal. Otherwise separate files are fine. We need this by Monday 2026-10-04 COB — apologies for the tight window.

Thanks,
Audrey Collins
Senior SIG Analyst
BlueBank

(Attachment: request-form_bluebank_SIG_v2.pdf)

Hi Audrey —

Appreciate the details and the deadline. We have prepared an initial bundle; attaching the exports you asked for. Quick summary below and I included where to look for more detail: 

What’s attached:
- pr_audit_export_202609.zip — CSVs per repo (author, reviewers, approvals, merge_commit, review comments snapshot).
- ci_pipeline_snippets.txt — redacted pipeline steps showing ephemeral secret acquisition and agent identity exchange.
- secret-stewardship-matrix.pdf — mapping of secret owners, rotation cadence, and KMS roles.

Notes / Highlights:
- The infra-serving emergency change on 2026-09-15 was a hotfix to address a kernel driver regression. The change was deployed under the emergency flow; approval chain is captured in merge_gate_exception_log_20260915.csv (included in the bundle).
- KMS/escrow transfers are recorded in escrow_transfer_log_20260915.txt (redacted for credential values but includes user and timestamp).
- For CI we use short-lived tokens from the ephemeral broker service; the ci_pipeline_snippets file includes the broker request and the step that calls the secret for the build. We do not store secret plaintext in the repo.

We are happy to walk through the files if you want a screen share; I can do a 30-min call tomorrow morning (10/3) between 8–11am PT.

Jonas Weber

1) For the 2026-09-15 emergency change: can you provide the exact approver identities (full name and Redwood username) and the rollback authorization note? The CSV has event ids but we need human-readable approval text for the assessor.

If you can drop those three items as separate attachments, that should close most of our open asks. Ideally before your morning call so we can bring any follow-ups.
